workshops.label: Designing for iOS
workshops.scope: Original HTML adaptation. Text scaling and layout changes are browser studies, not native Dynamic Type or iPhone gesture validation.

scenarios.title: Library & return
scenarios.task: Open an article, save it, and return to the same collection.
scenarios.principle: Prioritize primary content; retain an obvious return path.

scenarios.title: Search & no results
scenarios.task: Find an article, then recover from a search with no matches.
scenarios.principle: Make the next action clear in both useful and empty states.

scenarios.title: Edit & cancel
scenarios.task: Edit a note in a focused sheet, validate an empty title, and cancel without losing the original.
scenarios.principle: Keep secondary editing discoverable and preserve the main task.

scenarios.title: Navigation & saved state
scenarios.task: Save an article in Library and find it under Saved without losing its state.
scenarios.principle: Use stable destinations for distinct top-level tasks.

scenarios.title: Adaptable reading
scenarios.task: Change the study width, text size, and appearance while keeping the same reading task.
scenarios.principle: Adapt to the configurations people choose without losing content.

scenarios.title: Loading & recovery
scenarios.task: Load a local collection, cancel it, or simulate a failure and retry.
scenarios.principle: Keep task state and recovery actions understandable.

workshops.label: Designing for iPadOS
workshops.scope: A responsive HTML document workspace. Keyboard and pointer tasks run in the browser; native multitasking, Apple Pencil and inter-app transfer remain unverified.

scenarios.title: Persistent workspace
scenarios.task: Switch collections and documents while preserving each editable draft.
scenarios.principle: Use the available display for content and connected tasks, with less nesting.

scenarios.title: Resize without losing work
scenarios.task: Edit a draft, then change layout and text size without losing the selected document.
scenarios.principle: Adapt to available space and chosen configurations rather than a fixed tablet width.

scenarios.title: Nonmodal inspector
scenarios.task: Inspect document details while editing the same document.
scenarios.principle: Expose useful supporting information without interrupting the main task.

scenarios.title: Keyboard & named actions
scenarios.task: Save using the scoped keyboard command and the visible equivalent button.
scenarios.principle: Let people combine input methods without hiding essential actions.

scenarios.title: Sketch beside a note
scenarios.task: Draw or add a sample stroke, then transfer a bundled clip into a related note.
scenarios.principle: Support mixed-input workflows while stating what the browser model actually establishes.

workshops.label: Designing for macOS
workshops.scope: An original HTML document and command workspace. System menu bars, windows, file coordination, native full-screen and precision-device behavior require macOS validation.

scenarios.title: Documents without lost drafts
scenarios.task: Edit two documents and return to each preserved draft.
scenarios.principle: Use available display space for connected work with less nesting.

scenarios.title: Discoverable commands & undo
scenarios.task: Open the command list, create a document, apply a revision, and undo it.
scenarios.principle: Provide named commands and useful keyboard equivalents; keep recovery available.

scenarios.title: Personalize a toolbar
scenarios.task: Choose which optional toolbar commands are visible while preserving the draft.
scenarios.principle: Allow a workspace to reflect the person’s preferred tools and views.

scenarios.title: A focused work context
scenarios.task: Enter and leave a local focused layout without losing edited content.
scenarios.principle: Let the person choose a distraction-reduced working context.

scenarios.title: Precise, named adjustments
scenarios.task: Position a marker with a range control or one-step named buttons.
scenarios.principle: Support precise control and keyboard access without requiring a pointer gesture.

workshops.label: Designing for watchOS
workshops.scope: Original watch-sized web studies of brief tasks. Native complications, notifications, Always On, sensors, Action button, and Digital Crown behavior are not exercised.

scenarios.title: One useful glance
scenarios.task: Read the next action and choose another bundled context.
scenarios.principle: Keep critical information concise, relevant, and actionable.

scenarios.title: Start, pause, resume
scenarios.task: Run a short timer, pause it, and reset without navigating through setup screens.
scenarios.principle: Make a focused task available with few actions and clear state.

scenarios.title: Rotary input alternatives
scenarios.task: Choose a duration through an ordinary range control or named step buttons.
scenarios.principle: Support convenient adjustment without requiring a hardware-only gesture.

scenarios.title: Glance to useful detail
scenarios.task: Open a complication-like entry and return to the same concise context.
scenarios.principle: Use a relevant entry point to reach useful app detail directly.

scenarios.title: A targeted notification action
scenarios.task: Acknowledge a bundled event or open its details without a long setup flow.
scenarios.principle: Reserve interruptions for timely, useful information and relevant actions.

workshops.label: Designing for iPhone Duo
workshops.scope: Source-guided responsive HTML models of display transitions and reserved space. No hardware pose detection, native reserved-region APIs, or device dimensions are implemented.

scenarios.title: One hierarchy, changing space
scenarios.task: Open a note on the compact display model, then show its collection beside it.
scenarios.principle: Expand the existing hierarchy when space permits; keep the same task and content.

scenarios.title: Preserve the work
scenarios.task: Edit multiple notes and change display context without losing selection or drafts.
scenarios.principle: Maintain state and functionality across display and pose changes.

scenarios.title: Adapt around reserved space
scenarios.task: Toggle camera and folding-region illustrations while keeping content operable.
scenarios.principle: Move only what is necessary to keep content and controls clear of reserved regions.

scenarios.title: Arrange content, retain navigation
scenarios.task: Compare split and layered content arrangements, then change the available context.
scenarios.principle: Use arrangement for content layout; keep navigation outside it.

scenarios.title: Keep useful actions available
scenarios.task: Compress secondary actions, create a note, and find the same tag action in overflow.
scenarios.principle: Preserve frequent actions, meaningful groupings, labels, and a consistent overflow route.

workshops.label: Design principles
workshops.scope: Eight original interactive studies, one for each current named Apple design principle. Product decisions and illustrative outcomes are not universal rules or design certification.

scenarios.title: Purpose · capture the useful thought
scenarios.task: Capture a useful note directly; recover from empty input.
scenarios.principle: Choose a meaningful goal and prioritize the task that serves it.

scenarios.title: Agency · make recovery easy
scenarios.task: Archive a note, then recover the same content with Undo.
scenarios.principle: Let people explore and recover without losing their time or work.

scenarios.title: Responsibility · explain data use
scenarios.task: Choose manual place entry or inspect a bundled location example.
scenarios.principle: Be transparent about purpose and collect only what the real task needs.

scenarios.title: Familiarity · consistent action feedback
scenarios.task: Save either of two notes using the same named action and state feedback.
scenarios.principle: Apply established behaviors consistently and show when content changes.

scenarios.title: Flexibility · alternative input paths
scenarios.task: Reorder an itinerary with named keyboard-operable actions, then change layout or text size.
scenarios.principle: Accommodate different inputs and contexts while preserving the person’s work.

scenarios.title: Simplicity · reveal relevant options
scenarios.task: Write a note, reveal its optional category, and return without losing either value.
scenarios.principle: Keep the main task clear while retaining useful secondary capability.

scenarios.title: Craft · refine a real detail
scenarios.task: Refine a title, inspect empty-input validation, cancel, and save a better version.
scenarios.principle: Prototype, inspect the details, and iterate; shipping does not end design work.

scenarios.title: Delight · a useful finishing moment
scenarios.task: Complete a quiet planning task, then reopen it when plans change.
scenarios.principle: Let the appropriate emotion emerge from a considerate, useful experience.

workshops.label: Designing for games
workshops.scope: A playable original browser trail game with scoped keys, named controls, settings, pause and local checkpoints. It does not implement Game Center, GameSave, native controllers, haptics, spatial input or full screen.

scenarios.title: Teach through playable defaults
scenarios.task: Reach camp through play, without a mandatory setup or account flow.
scenarios.principle: Provide useful defaults and teach mechanics in the context of play.

scenarios.title: Adapt the play space
scenarios.task: Change aspect-ratio model and layout while preserving the player and readable controls.
scenarios.principle: Use adaptable layouts and keep important content usable across displays.

scenarios.title: Inputs with equal access
scenarios.task: Use named buttons or focus the board and choose Arrow or WASD keys.
scenarios.principle: Support the target platform’s expected inputs and offer alternatives to physical controllers.

scenarios.title: Perceive and personalize
scenarios.task: Choose stronger cell outlines and story captions; finish using labeled controls.
scenarios.principle: Do not rely on color alone; support useful personalization and varied abilities.

scenarios.title: Pause and recover progress
scenarios.task: Store a local checkpoint, play further, pause, and restore the saved position.
scenarios.principle: Support continuity while distinguishing an in-memory model from native cross-device saving.

workshops.label: Designing for tvOS
workshops.scope: Original illustrated TV-content browser studies. Arrow-key navigation models focus decisions; it does not exercise Siri Remote, the native focus engine, shared sign-in, video playback, or picture-in-picture.

scenarios.title: Focus, open, return
scenarios.task: Navigate a directional grid, open a story, and return to its focused item.
scenarios.principle: Keep the current location and the next available action clear.

scenarios.title: Readable from a distance
scenarios.task: Choose a room-reading text treatment while retaining focus and reachable stories.
scenarios.principle: Use artwork, hierarchy and legible information for the viewing context; test the real room.

scenarios.title: A shared screen, separate lists
scenarios.task: Save a story for Alex, switch to Sam, and verify the lists remain independent.
scenarios.principle: Support multiple viewers and preserve the active person’s context.

scenarios.title: A concise sign-in handoff model
scenarios.task: Recover from an invalid sample code and complete the bundled local flow.
scenarios.principle: Keep sign-in understandable and infrequent; evaluate actual shared sign-in integrations.

scenarios.title: Continue a story while browsing
scenarios.task: Advance a bundled illustrated story, pause it, and keep its place in a smaller presentation.
scenarios.principle: Preserve context when the person changes presentation or follows another task.

workshops.label: Designing for visionOS
workshops.scope: Stationary, original 2D browser illustrations of windowed tasks, immersion choices, objects and sharing state. No spatial tracking, gaze, hand gestures, passthrough, Spatial Audio or SharePlay is implemented.

scenarios.title: A contained, familiar task
scenarios.task: Edit a note and open supporting details without leaving the task.
scenarios.principle: Prefer a familiar window for a UI-centric task, with useful supporting controls.

scenarios.title: Choose and leave immersion
scenarios.task: Enter an illustrated focused context deliberately, then exit with the note preserved.
scenarios.principle: Choose the minimum immersion appropriate to the moment and preserve the person’s agency.

scenarios.title: Select through named alternatives
scenarios.task: Choose an illustrated object and change its orientation with a range or named step action.
scenarios.principle: Make selection and manipulation understandable; test actual indirect/direct input separately.

scenarios.title: A stable reference for work
scenarios.task: Keep an editable task beside a visible stable reference and inspect the illustration’s presentation.
scenarios.principle: Prioritize comfort, avoid overwhelming motion, and keep important content easy to find.

scenarios.title: Shared activity with a clear exit
scenarios.task: Review a bundled invitation, simulate its acceptance, and leave while preserving the note.
scenarios.principle: Support a shared task with understandable participation and an available way to leave.

workshops.label: Getting started
workshops.scope: An original planning workflow built around Apple’s Getting started topic index and its nine child topics. Briefs and downloads remain unreviewed drafts; no automated design certification is produced.

scenarios.title: Name a person’s task
scenarios.task: Create a scoped draft brief with a goal, target platform and explicit OS.
scenarios.principle: Establish the design context before choosing structure or styling.

scenarios.title: Choose the relevant sources
scenarios.task: Choose a platform, then open its workshop or any Getting started child topic.
scenarios.principle: Use Apple’s topic relationships as a source map; verify exact sections for consequential claims.

scenarios.title: Compare two plausible structures
scenarios.task: Compare a focused flow with a connected workspace while retaining the same draft.
scenarios.principle: Choose a structure for the task and platform; retain context as it adapts.

scenarios.title: Build the paths that can fail
scenarios.task: Submit, cancel, trigger a bundled failure, retry, and return with the draft intact.
scenarios.principle: Inspect real entry, loading, error, cancellation and recovery states.

scenarios.title: Keep an honest decision draft
scenarios.task: Describe a source-linked decision and export its explicitly unreviewed record.
scenarios.principle: Separate recommendations, original choices, implementation evidence and unverified claims.
